decision.meaning: Real candidate tensor bytes from teamblobfish IQ1_M shard1 pass down-stream parity for Q2_K and IQ1_M row slices. This removes a key correctness concern for these down tensor types but is still not a full-model acceptance gate.
limitations: Only small row slices were fetched and tested.
No full model was loaded or generated from.
No prompt-general token-rate, TTFT, RAM, or semantic correctness benchmark was run.
IQ1_S-XL candidate still needs equivalent real-byte parity or full load/correctness after download.
decision.next_step: Repeat the range-byte parity method for teamblobfish IQ1_S-XL if its header can be parsed, then only proceed to full compact target load after disk cleanup/download approval.
